fullUrlAlgorithm.name: uuid-v5-jcs-identifier-v1
fullUrlAlgorithm.input: UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme serialization of exactly [system,value]

stringRules.unicode: system and value MUST contain only Unicode scalar values; isolated UTF-16 surrogates are rejected
stringRules.escaping: escape quotation mark and reverse solidus; use the two-character escapes \b, \t, \n, \f and \r; encode every other U+0000 through U+001F control as lowercase \u00xx; do not escape solidus or any other scalar value
stringRules.encoding: encode the resulting JSON text as UTF-8 without a byte-order mark
stringRules.array: quotation mark, serialized system, quotation mark, comma, quotation mark, serialized value, quotation mark; no whitespace

internalReferences.bundleEntryReferences: must use an entry fullUrl UUID URN

recordingDeviceIdentity.purpose: A recording Device deduplicates across every Observation it produced, so one physical recorder is stored once per configuration instead of once per sample.

digest.input: UTF-8 without BOM of the RFC 8785/JCS serialization of the preimage array

keyKinds.model-class: The source states no per-unit identifier, so the key is the product configuration. This identifies a model owned by one repository, not an individual unit; two identical units in one repository deduplicate into one Device.
keyKinds.local-identifier: The platform states an opaque installation-local device identifier and the deployment has authorized its use through recordingDeviceIdentifierSystem.

recordingDeviceIdentity.precedence: local-identifier takes precedence when the deployment authorizes it; otherwise model-class. Changing that authorization re-identifies every recording Device, so a deployment fixes it before its first export.
recordingDeviceIdentity.versionsParticipate: The firmware and software versions participate because the Device resource represents them, as the adapter content rule requires. A configuration change therefore mints a new Device rather than mutating a shared one, which keeps every emitted Device immutable and makes an out-of-order backfill write byte-identical content.
recordingDeviceIdentity.failClosed: A model-class key requires a non-empty manufacturer and at least one of model or hardwareVersion. A source that states less has no admitted device identity; the producer emits its per-sample derived identity instead of asserting a shared device.
prohibitedInputs: subject references, Resource.id, repository ids, and processing timestamps
vendor per-unit identifiers and serial numbers, including a digest of one

lexicalRules.absentField: An absent source field is the empty string; it is never omitted from the array.
lexicalRules.normalization: Source strings are used exactly as the platform states them; no trimming, case folding, or Unicode normalization is applied.
